page_title: EIN 0-3 BAY | Eintracht Frankfurt v Bayern Munich 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.
90+4' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+3' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
90+2' The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Luis Diaz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Sacha Boey is replaced by Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich).
85' The substitution is prepared. Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Harry Kane.

84' 0 - 3 Fantastic team effort! Raphael Guerreiro is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the inside of the left post to make the score 0:3.
83' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
82' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Burkardt will be replaced by Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
81' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
81' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
79' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) was probably a bit loose with his words to Daniel Siebert, who decides to show him a yellow.
79' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul after Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) hacks down one of his opponents.
78' The substitution has been made. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
78' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Ellyes Skhiri and he is replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' Bayern Munich are seeing far more of the ball now.
75' Flag up against Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
72' Daniel Siebert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
71' The attendance for today's match is 59500.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Serge Gnabry.
70' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Manuel Neuer scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
69' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) for a tough tackle.
67' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
65' The game has come to an end for Hugo Larsson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Can Yilmaz Uzun.
62' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
61' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
57' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is flagged for offside.
55' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) misses a great chance. He gets to the rebound inside the box and sees his shot smash against the left post!
55' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
54' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
52' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayern Munich. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
50' A clever short pass gives Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
46' Daniel Siebert blows for a foul after Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is replaced by Aleksandar Pavlovic.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' The linesman signals that Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

43' That's unlucky! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.

40' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
38' 34:66 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
35' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
34' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
32' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
31' A precise low pass is received by Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.

27' 0 - 2 Luis Diaz passes to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:2.
25' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
23' Kaua Santos steps in and intercepts a long pass from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
20' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
17' Celebrations are cut short for Eintracht Frankfurt as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
15' Wait! Referee Daniel Siebert has indicated he is going to review the Eintracht Frankfurt goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
14' The main referee, Daniel Siebert, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is given a yellow card for dissent.

14' It's in the back of the net! Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a brilliant volley into the top left corner from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Hugo Larsson provided the assist. What a finish! 1:1.
10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
10' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
7' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
7' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Serge Gnabry feeds Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will supervise the game today.
